requirements.statement: The router shall load and replay an offline-produced calendar whose slot entries select an input port, output-port mask, and opcode for a single collective operation.
acceptance_criteria: A BFM replaying every slot of a supplied calendar produces the entry's specified port selection, output mask, and opcode.
A BFM selects and replays distinct supplied calendars for broadcast, allgather, gather, reduce, and allreduce operations.
ambiguities: [AMBIGUITY: REQ-F-001] Calendar loading protocol, table depth, calendar_id width, slot width, and calendar epoch/reset behavior are not specified.
requirements.description: The router shall load and replay an offline-produced calendar whose slot entries select an input port, output-port mask, and opcode for a single collective operation.

requirements.statement: The router shall support calendar-scheduled broadcast and allgather using multicast fork and multi-source injection as encoded by the selected calendar.
acceptance_criteria: For every legal 6x8 broadcast/allgather schedule supplied to the BFM, each scheduled destination receives exactly one copy of each intended flit.
No output port emits more than one flit in a cycle from a single router.
requirements.description: The router shall support calendar-scheduled broadcast and allgather using multicast fork and multi-source injection as encoded by the selected calendar.

requirements.statement: The router shall support calendar-scheduled gather using tree convergence without intermediate router arithmetic or operand combination.
acceptance_criteria: For every legal 6x8 gather calendar supplied to the BFM, every source's intended flit reaches the scheduled root exactly once.
For a supplied legal gather calendar, no router datapath combines, transforms, or suppresses gathered operands.
requirements.description: The router shall support calendar-scheduled gather using tree convergence without intermediate router arithmetic or operand combination.

requirements.statement: The router subsystem shall implement Trial 2 Tier A reduction: reduce is calendar-scheduled gather followed by PE-local compute, and allreduce is gather followed by PE-local compute and calendar-scheduled broadcast.
acceptance_criteria: The Trial 2 architecture and BFM model reduce by delivering every gathered source operand exactly once to the designated PE compute endpoint; no router combine transaction occurs.
The Trial 2 architecture and BFM model allreduce by completing gather, PE-local computation, and a calendar-scheduled broadcast of the computed result to every intended destination exactly once.
The Phase 2 comparison retains tiers A, B, and C at m=1..5 flits with makespan and relative area/power estimates, but Tier A is recorded as the USER_CONFIRMED Trial 2 selection.
ambiguities: [AMBIGUITY: REQ-F-004] Reduction operations, operand element format, identity value, ordering/associativity rules, and numerical accuracy requirements are not specified.
requirements.description: The router subsystem shall implement Trial 2 Tier A reduction: reduce is calendar-scheduled gather followed by PE-local compute, and allreduce is gather followed by PE-local compute and calendar-scheduled broadcast.

requirements.statement: The router shall provide always-available XY dimension-order unicast for background and non-scheduled traffic on the same 512-bit physical network used by calendar traffic.
acceptance_criteria: For every source/destination pair in the 6x8 mesh, a background packet follows X dimension hops before Y dimension hops.
Phase 2 selects and documents a numeric background-service bound for continuous legal calendar traffic; the Phase 3 BFM demonstrates delivery within that bound for the selected isolation mechanism.
ambiguities: [AMBIGUITY: REQ-F-005] Packet destination-coordinate encoding and the concrete progress bound for background traffic are not specified.
requirements.description: The router shall provide always-available XY dimension-order unicast for background and non-scheduled traffic on the same 512-bit physical network used by calendar traffic.

requirements.statement: The router shall fork one calendar flit to multiple output ports selected by its calendar entry or multicast mask.
acceptance_criteria: For every legal 6x8 broadcast/allgather schedule, each bit asserted in the selected output-port mask generates one output copy and each deasserted bit generates none.
The source flit is released only after every selected output copy has been accepted under the selected flow-control protocol.
ambiguities: [AMBIGUITY: REQ-F-006] The encoding and legal values of the multicast mask/fork fields are not specified.
requirements.description: The router shall fork one calendar flit to multiple output ports selected by its calendar entry or multicast mask.

requirements.statement: The calendar/background isolation mechanism shall preserve deadlock freedom for mixed traffic; background traffic uses XY-DOR and calendar traffic uses conflict-free offline schedules.
acceptance_criteria: Phase 2 supplies a channel-dependency or equivalent argument showing no cyclic resource dependency for the selected mixed-traffic design.
A BFM stress test containing concurrent legal calendar and XY background traffic completes without deadlock.
ambiguities: [AMBIGUITY: REQ-F-007] Isolation mechanism and VC count are deferred to Phase 2; XY alone does not establish deadlock freedom for an unspecified wormhole/VC implementation.
requirements.description: The calendar/background isolation mechanism shall preserve deadlock freedom for mixed traffic; background traffic uses XY-DOR and calendar traffic uses conflict-free offline schedules.

requirements.statement: The router shall use credit-based or equivalent ready/valid flow control and shall never overwrite a live flit or drop a flit because of normal backpressure.
acceptance_criteria: For all legal traffic in BFM tests, every accepted flit is delivered exactly once unless it is intentionally replicated by REQ-F-006.
A sender transmits only when the selected downstream availability indication permits it, and buffer occupancy never exceeds allocated capacity.
ambiguities: [AMBIGUITY: REQ-F-008] Credit count width, return latency, buffer depth, and whether ready/valid replaces credits are not specified.
requirements.description: The router shall use credit-based or equivalent ready/valid flow control and shall never overwrite a live flit or drop a flit because of normal backpressure.

requirements.statement: The router shall detect late, early, or wrong-port collective arrivals and preserve delivery by watchdog-triggered graceful degradation to an XY unicast or buffered path; it shall not drop the flit.
acceptance_criteria: A BFM injects each of late, early, and wrong-port collective cases and observes eventual delivery without packet loss.
Phase 2 selects and documents a numeric watchdog timeout and recovery-latency bound; a watchdog event produces exactly one recovery action without permanently blocking other traffic.
ambiguities: [AMBIGUITY: REQ-F-009] Watchdog timeout, error reporting, destination translation for a multicast flit demoted to unicast, and credit-reclaim semantics are not specified.
requirements.description: The router shall detect late, early, or wrong-port collective arrivals and preserve delivery by watchdog-triggered graceful degradation to an XY unicast or buffered path; it shall not drop the flit.

requirements.statement: Phase 2 shall retain a comparison of reduction tiers A (PE-local compute), B (router-local two-input integer/bitwise combine), and C (DCA tile-FPU offload) for reduce and allreduce; Tier A is selected for Trial 2.
acceptance_criteria: The comparison covers the 6x8 mesh, H=7, V=9, ramp_bw=1, and m=1..5 flits where applicable.
Each tier records makespan estimate, relative router area/power, robustness argument, and its relationship to the Trial 2 Tier A selection.
Trial 2 architecture documents contain no in-router combine datapath or DCA request/response interface.
ambiguities: [AMBIGUITY: REQ-F-010] SoC FPU availability, DCA latency/throughput, and concurrent core/DCA arbitration policy are not specified.
requirements.description: Phase 2 shall retain a comparison of reduction tiers A (PE-local compute), B (router-local two-input integer/bitwise combine), and C (DCA tile-FPU offload) for reduce and allreduce; Tier A is selected for Trial 2.

requirements.statement: Trial 2 shall not instantiate or require a router DCA request/response interface; Tier C remains comparison-only evidence.
acceptance_criteria: The Trial 2 architecture and interface definition contain no DCA operand, opcode, tag, request, response, or backpressure port.
The base five-port router remains functional for all Trial 2 collectives without DCA transactions.
ambiguities: [AMBIGUITY: REQ-F-011] A future DCA request/response protocol, tag width, opcode width, FPU latency, and configuration mechanism remain unspecified and are outside Trial 2.
requirements.description: Trial 2 shall not instantiate or require a router DCA request/response interface; Tier C remains comparison-only evidence.

requirements.statement: Phase 3 shall provide a SystemC BFM that replays 6x8 calendars derived from superpose_6x8.json or an equivalent schedule and reports makespan.
acceptance_criteria: The BFM replays at least one calendar for each supported collective semantic selected by Phase 2.
The BFM emits makespan in cycles and identifies the baseline profile used for comparison.
ambiguities: [AMBIGUITY: REQ-F-012] BFM API, test ownership, schedule file encoding, and pass/fail tolerance are not specified.
requirements.description: Phase 3 shall provide a SystemC BFM that replays 6x8 calendars derived from superpose_6x8.json or an equivalent schedule and reports makespan.

requirements.statement: Each physical mesh direction shall carry one 64-byte (512-bit) flit per cycle when granted.
acceptance_criteria: At 2 GHz, a continuously granted direction accepts and emits 1 flit/cycle (64 B/cycle, 128 GB/s decimal per direction).
No router arbitration or flow-control mechanism reduces this rate when the direction is continuously granted and downstream capacity is available.
requirements.description: Each physical mesh direction shall carry one 64-byte (512-bit) flit per cycle when granted.

requirements.statement: The analytic timing model shall use noc_clk at 2 GHz, with horizontal link delay H=7 cycles (3.5 ns), vertical link delay V=9 cycles (4.5 ns), and PE-router ramp latency of 1 cycle (0.5 ns).
acceptance_criteria: All Phase 2 makespan estimates use a 0.5 ns cycle period and the stated H, V, and ramp parameters.
Any different timing value is treated as a user-escalated model change.
ambiguities: [AMBIGUITY: REQ-P-002] Router pipeline latency is not specified separately from the link-delay model.
requirements.description: The analytic timing model shall use noc_clk at 2 GHz, with horizontal link delay H=7 cycles (3.5 ns), vertical link delay V=9 cycles (4.5 ns), and PE-router ramp latency of 1 cycle (0.5 ns).

requirements.statement: Selected calendar hardware shall be evaluated for makespan overhead against the published 6x8 ag_bcast, ag_gather, and solo schedule baselines for m=1..5 flits, without silently changing schedule inputs.
acceptance_criteria: The report includes all 10 ag_bcast/ag_gather makespans: ag_bcast=[167,267,310,524,708] cycles and ag_gather=[170,310,368,628,898] cycles for m=1..5.
For each evaluated design, overhead is reported as (estimated_makespan - baseline_makespan) / baseline_makespan for every applicable m and profile.
ambiguities: [AMBIGUITY: REQ-P-003] No maximum allowable overhead is specified; 'minimize' is an optimization objective, not a pass/fail bound.
requirements.description: Selected calendar hardware shall be evaluated for makespan overhead against the published 6x8 ag_bcast, ag_gather, and solo schedule baselines for m=1..5 flits, without silently changing schedule inputs.

requirements.statement: The DSE shall use an analytic power/area model that explicitly states SRAM bitcell, crossbar mux, VC-buffer-flit, and calendar-table-depth assumptions and targets relative router area below 1.065× the baseline five-port XY router.
acceptance_criteria: The Trial 2 selected design report enumerates the four specified model assumptions and reports a relative router area below 1.065× baseline.
The report calibrates multicast against the cited approximately +5.8% FlooNoC router delta; the +2.7% parallel-reduce and +16.9% DCA figures are comparison-only anchors for rejected tiers.
ambiguities: [AMBIGUITY: REQ-P-004] Process node, absolute power/area target, and a required calibration error bound are not specified.
requirements.description: The DSE shall use an analytic power/area model that explicitly states SRAM bitcell, crossbar mux, VC-buffer-flit, and calendar-table-depth assumptions and targets relative router area below 1.065× the baseline five-port XY router.

requirements.statement: If tier C DCA is selected, the analytic evaluation shall include the cited target that full tile area impact remains below 1% and the router-wide-path impact is approximately the +16.9% reference class.
acceptance_criteria: The DCA candidate report separately states estimated router and tile area deltas.
The report explicitly identifies whether its SoC assumptions support or reject the cited <1% tile-area preference.
ambiguities: [AMBIGUITY: REQ-P-005] The <1% and +16.9% values are literature calibration references, not binding targets for the unspecified SoC process/library.
requirements.description: If tier C DCA is selected, the analytic evaluation shall include the cited target that full tile area impact remains below 1% and the router-wide-path impact is approximately the +16.9% reference class.
